label: Heureka (PPC and Product Ads)
terms_note: Bidding API: 'potvrdit smlouvu o službě, poté obdržíte přístup/token a dokumentaci' (paid, access_key), JSON-RPC at api.heureka.cz/bidding_api/v1 (+ .sk); CPC via admin (recalculated every 30 min) or XML feed HEUREKA_CPC (max 1,000 CZK/click); credit top-ups. Free listing + PPC modes.

discovery.auth: api_key (access_key token issued after signing the Bidding API contract; JSON-RPC)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** — paid JSON-RPC Bidding API (product-card data for bidding) + CPC via XML feed / admin; no campaign API.Confidence: **high**.
auth: 1. Sign the Bidding API service contract → receive `access_key` token + documentation.
2. JSON-RPC calls with `access_key` in params (Python `json-rpc` library suggested).
3. Set CPC in Heureka admin (Bidding – Price settings, recalculated every 30 min) or in the XML feed with `HEUREKA_CPC` (imported every ~2 h); max 1,000 CZK/click.

endpoints.call: category.index` · product / offer methods (competitor prices, positions, shipping)
XML feed `HEUREKA_CPC` per item · admin Bidding settings

reference.limits: - Paid API (contract); 1 h server-side cache on shipping prices and category index; Heureka VOP terms.

reason: Re-checked 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium: Heureka's only public API reference is the paid Bidding API (https://api.heureka.cz/bidding_api/v1/apidoc) with methods access_rate.index, category.index/get and product.index/get (catalog and competitor-offer data to decide bids), issued with an access_key after signing a contract (https://sluzby.heureka.cz/napoveda/bidding-api/). It has no advertiser account, campaign, CPC-bid, budget or spend-report method, so none of the ads verbs maps; PPC bids are set via the XML feed / shop administration behind the shop login.
